mentions.name: pilab-esp32-p4-plc
mentions.description: A software-defined automation project (PLC) built on ESP32-P4 hardware. Users open a webpage, write code, and it is uploaded and runs instantly on the device. The project is MIT licensed and available in a public git repository.
mentions.problem: The author wanted a frictionless way to write code in a webpage and have it uploaded and run instantly on hardware.
mentions.source_excerpt: I started a new software defined automation project.  I wanted something that I could just open a webpage and start writing code that could just be uploaded and ran instantly.  I picked an ESP32-P4 for the first hardware.  It’s MIT licensed and has a git repo that I put up this morning https://github.com/OpenPiLab/pilab-esp32-p4-plc
